component.name: foxreach
component.summary: Manage foxreach: browsers, agents, updates and removal

description.p: foxreach lets local MCP agents use the browser tabs you share with them. This app sets it up and keeps it current: it installs the foxreach program, installs or updates the signed add-on in each Firefox-based browser profile, chooses which agents get the MCP server, and removes any part of it, or all of it.
Every change is made by the foxreach program itself, the same commands the terminal offers. To do its work the app runs programs on your computer outside its sandbox (see the README).
